content:
Track: Introduction to Data Analysis with Python (Python Basics for Analysts)
    - Lesson 1: Python Environment Setup and Basics
    - Lesson 2: Python Data Structures: Lists, Tuples, Dictionaries
    - Lesson 3: Control Structures: If-Else, Loops (For, While)
    - Lesson 4: Functions and Modules in Python
    - Lesson 5: Importing External Libraries and Pandas Basics
    - Lesson 6: Data Manipulation with Pandas
    - Lesson 7: Introduction to Data Cleaning Techniques
    - Lesson 8: Data Aggregations using Pandas
    - Lesson 9: Visualizing Data with Matplotlib (Part 1)
    - Lesson 10: Visualizing Data with Matplotlib (Part 2)

   Track: SQL Fundamentals for Analysts
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL Commands and Syntax (SELECT, FROM, WHERE)
    - Lesson 3: JOIN Operations in SQL (Inner, Outer, Left, Right)
    - Lesson 4: Grouping Data with GROUP BY Clause
    - Lesson 5: Aggregate Functions in SQL (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX)
    - Lesson 6: Subqueries and Nested Queries in SQL
    - Lesson 7: Database Normalization and Design Principles
    - Lesson 8: SQL Transactions and Constraints
    - Lesson 9: Introduction to Database Management Systems (DBMS)
    - Lesson 10: Real-world SQL Case Studies

   Track: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing Techniques
    - Lesson 1: Handling Missing Values in Datasets
    - Lesson 2: Outlier Detection and Removal Strategies
    - Lesson 3: Text Data Cleaning (Removing Stopwords, Stemming, Lemmatization)
    - Lesson 4: Handling Imbalanced Datasets
    - Lesson 5: Merging, Concatenating, and Joining Multiple Datasets
    - Lesson 6: Feature Engineering Techniques
    - Lesson 7: Data Encoding (One-Hot Encoding, Label Encoding)
    - Lesson 8: Data Scaling and Normalization
    - Lesson 9: Sampling Strategies in Python (Random, Stratified, etc.)
    - Lesson 10: Real-world Scenarios for Data Cleaning and Preprocessing

   Track: Exploratory Data Analysis with Python
    - Lesson 1: Importing Datasets and Descriptive Statistics
    - Lesson 2: Correlation Matrix, Heatmaps, and Pairplots
    - Lesson 3: Box Plots, Violin Plots, and Q-Q Plots
    - Lesson 4: Time Series Analysis (Trends, Seasonality)
    - Lesson 5: Data Visualization Best Practices
    - Lesson 6: Interactive Dashboards using Bokeh or Plotly
    - Lesson 7: Introduction to Clustering Techniques (K-Means)
    - Lesson 8: Supervised Learning Basics (Regression, Classification)
    - Lesson 9: Decision Trees and Random Forests
    - Lesson 10: Real-world EDA Case Studies

   Track: Business Intelligence with Power BI
    - Lesson 1: Power BI Environment Setup and Basics
    - Lesson 2: Data Modeling in Power BI
    - Lesson 3: Creating Charts, Tables, and Cards
    - Lesson 4: Data Visualization Best Practices (Power BI)
    - Lesson 5: Advanced Dashboards and Reports
    - Lesson 6: Interactive Filters and Slicers in Power BI
    - Lesson 7: Working with Real-time Data (Streaming, DAX Calculations)
    - Lesson 8: Sharing and Collaborating on Dashboards in Power BI
    - Lesson 9: Building Mobile Reports using Power BI Mobile Apps
    - Lesson 10: Real-world Business Intelligence Case Studies (Power BI)
